def print_help(cmd: Optional[str]=None):
    if cmd in ("check",): print(CHECK_HELP, end="")
    elif cmd in ("fmt",): print(CHECK_HELP.replace("Lint Markdown files and print warnings/errors", "Format Markdown files (alias for check --fix)").replace("Usage: executable check", "Usage: executable fmt"), end="")
    else: print(MAIN_HELP, end="")

def main(argv: List[str]) -> int:
    if not argv or argv[0] in ("-h","--help"):
        print_help(); return 0
    if argv[0] in ("-V","--version"):
        print(f"rumdl {VERSION}"); return 0
    argv, explicit_cfg, no_config, color = extract_global_options(argv)
    if not argv:
        print_help(); return 0
    if argv[0] == "help":
        print_help(argv[1] if len(argv)>1 else None); return 0
    cmd=argv[0]; rest=argv[1:]
    if "--help" in rest or "-h" in rest:
        if cmd in ("check","fmt"): print_help(cmd); return 0
        # concise generic
        print_help(cmd); return 0
    cfg, cfg_path = load_config(explicit_cfg, no_config)
    if cmd == "check": return run_check(rest, cfg, False)
    if cmd == "fmt": return run_check(rest, cfg, True)
    if cmd == "init": return run_init(rest)
    if cmd == "rule": return run_rule(rest)
    if cmd == "explain": return run_explain(rest)
    if cmd == "config": return run_config(rest, cfg, cfg_path)
    if cmd == "version": print(f"rumdl {VERSION}"); return 0
    if cmd == "import": return run_import(rest)
    if cmd == "clean": print("Cache cleared"); return 0
    if cmd == "schema": print(json.dumps({"$schema":"http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#","title":"rumdl configuration","type":"object"}, indent=2)); return 0
    if cmd == "server": return 0
    if cmd == "vscode": print("VS Code extension support is not available in this build"); return 1
    if cmd == "completions": return 0
    print(f"error: unrecognized subcommand '{cmd}'")
    print("\nUsage: executable [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>")
    return 2

if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

@dataclass
class Diagnostic:
    file: str
    line: int
    col: int
    rule: str
    message: str
    fixable: bool = False
    start: Optional[int] = None
    end: Optional[int] = None
    replacement: str = ""

    def to_json(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        d = {"file": self.file, "line": self.line, "column": self.col, "rule": self.rule, "message": self.message, "severity": "warning", "fixable": bool(self.fixable)}
        if self.fixable:
            d["fix"] = {"range": {"start": self.start or 0, "end": self.end or (self.start or 0)}, "replacement": self.replacement}
        return d

# ---------- utility/config ----------

def deep_copy_config() -> Dict[str, Any]:
    return json.loads(json.dumps(DEFAULT_CONFIG))

def merge_dict(a: Dict[str, Any], b: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    for k, v in b.items():
        if isinstance(v, dict) and isinstance(a.get(k), dict):
            merge_dict(a[k], v)
        else:
            a[k] = v

def load_config(explicit: Optional[str], no_config: bool) -> Tuple[Dict[str, Any], Optional[str]]:
    cfg = deep_copy_config()
    if no_config:
        return cfg, None
    candidates: List[Path] = []
    if explicit:
        candidates = [Path(explicit)]
    else:
        cur = Path.cwd()
        for p in [cur, *cur.parents]:
            for name in (".rumdl.toml", "rumdl.toml", "pyproject.toml"):
                f = p / name
                if f.exists():
                    candidates = [f]
                    break
            if candidates:
                break
    if not candidates:
        return cfg, None
    path = candidates[0]
    try:
        data = tomllib.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if tomllib else {}
        if path.name == "pyproject.toml":
            data = data.get("tool", {}).get("rumdl", {})
        # Accept [global] and also top-level pyproject-ish keys.
        converted: Dict[str, Any] = {}
        if any(k in data for k in ("disable", "enable", "exclude", "include", "respect-gitignore", "respect_gitignore", "flavor", "line-length")):
            converted["global"] = {}
            for k in ("disable", "enable", "exclude", "include", "flavor"):
                if k in data: converted["global"][k] = data[k]
            if "respect-gitignore" in data: converted["global"]["respect_gitignore"] = data["respect-gitignore"]
            if "respect_gitignore" in data: converted["global"]["respect_gitignore"] = data["respect_gitignore"]
            if "line-length" in data: converted.setdefault("MD013", {})["line-length"] = data["line-length"]
        for k, v in data.items():
            kk = k.upper() if re.fullmatch(r"md\d{3}", k, re.I) else k
            if kk == "global" or kk in RULES or kk in ("per-file-ignores",):
                converted[kk] = v
        merge_dict(cfg, converted)
        return cfg, str(path.resolve())
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error: Failed to load configuration: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        return cfg, str(path.resolve())

def extract_global_options(argv: List[str]) -> Tuple[List[str], Optional[str], bool, str]:
    out: List[str] = []
    config = None
    no_config = False
    color = "auto"
    i = 0
    while i < len(argv):
        a = argv[i]
        if a in ("--config",):
            if i + 1 < len(argv): config = argv[i+1]; i += 2; continue
        elif a.startswith("--config="):
            config = a.split("=", 1)[1]; i += 1; continue
        elif a in ("--no-config", "--isolated"):
            no_config = True; i += 1; continue
        elif a == "--color":
            if i+1 < len(argv): color = argv[i+1]; i += 2; continue
        elif a.startswith("--color="):
            color = a.split("=",1)[1]; i += 1; continue
        out.append(a); i += 1
    return out, config, no_config, color

def normalize_rule_token(tok: str) -> Optional[str]:
    t = tok.strip()
    if not t: return None
    u = t.upper()
    if re.fullmatch(r"MD\d{3}", u): return u if u in RULES else u
    return ALIAS.get(t) or ALIAS.get(t.lower())

def parse_rule_list(s: Optional[str]) -> List[str]:
    if not s: return []
    parts = re.split(r"[,\s]+", s.strip())
    return [r for p in parts if (r := normalize_rule_token(p))]

def active_rules(cfg: Dict[str, Any], enable: List[str], disable: List[str], ext_enable: List[str], ext_disable: List[str]) -> List[str]:
    cgen = [normalize_rule_token(x) or str(x).upper() for x in cfg.get("global", {}).get("enable", [])]
    cgdis = [normalize_rule_token(x) or str(x).upper() for x in cfg.get("global", {}).get("disable", [])]
    if enable:
        base = [r for r in enable if r in RULES]
    elif cgen:
        base = [r for r in cgen if r in RULES]
    else:
        base = RULE_ORDER[:]
    for r in ext_enable:
        if r in RULES and r not in base: base.append(r)
    disabled = set([r for r in cgdis + disable + ext_disable if r])
    return [r for r in base if r not in disabled]

def split_lines_keep(text: str) -> List[str]:
    if text == "": return []
    return text.splitlines(True)

def line_no_nl(line: str) -> str:
    return line[:-1] if line.endswith("\n") else line

def line_content(line: str) -> str:
    return line.rstrip("\n").rstrip("\r")

def offsets_for_lines(lines: List[str]) -> List[int]:
    offs=[]; pos=0
    for l in lines:
        offs.append(pos); pos += len(l)
    return offs

def is_blank(s: str) -> bool:
    return line_content(s).strip() == ""

def heading_info(raw: str) -> Optional[Tuple[int, str, bool]]:
    s = line_content(raw)
    m = re.match(r"^(#{1,6})(?:\s+|$)(.*?)(?:\s+#+\s*)?$", s)
    if m:
        text = re.sub(r"\s+#+\s*$", "", m.group(2)).strip()
        return len(m.group(1)), text, True
    return None

def heading_info_loose(raw: str) -> Optional[Tuple[int, str]]:
    s = line_content(raw)
    m = re.match(r"^\s*(#{1,6})(.*)$", s)
    if m and not re.match(r"^\s*#{7,}", s):
        rest = m.group(2).strip()
        rest = re.sub(r"\s+#+\s*$", "", rest).strip()
        return len(m.group(1)), rest
    return None

def setext_level(lines: List[str], idx: int) -> Optional[int]:
    if idx <= 0: return None
    s = line_content(lines[idx]).strip()
    if re.fullmatch(r"=+", s): return 1
    if re.fullmatch(r"-+", s): return 2
    return None

def is_fence(s: str) -> Optional[Tuple[str, int, str]]:
    t = line_content(s)
    m = re.match(r"^\s*(`{3,}|~{3,})(.*)$", t)
    if m:
        return m.group(1)[0], len(m.group(1)), m.group(2).strip()
    return None

def is_hr_line(s: str) -> bool:
    t = line_content(s).strip()
    return bool(re.fullmatch(r"(?:\*\s*){3,}|(?:-\s*){3,}|(?:_\s*){3,}", t))

def is_ul_item(s: str) -> Optional[re.Match[str]]:
    return re.match(r"^(\s*)([-+*])(\s+)(.*)$", line_content(s))

def is_ol_item(s: str) -> Optional[re.Match[str]]:
    return re.match(r"^(\s*)(\d+)([.)])(\s+)(.*)$", line_content(s))

def is_list_item(s: str) -> bool:
    return is_ul_item(s) is not None or is_ol_item(s) is not None

def is_table_line(s: str) -> bool:
    t = line_content(s).strip()
    if not t or "|" not in t: return False
    return True

def table_cells(s: str) -> List[str]:
    t = line_content(s).strip()
    if t.startswith("|"): t = t[1:]
    if t.endswith("|"): t = t[:-1]
    return [c.strip() for c in t.split("|")]

def github_anchor(text: str) -> str:
    x = text.strip().lower()
    x = re.sub(r"[`*_~]", "", x)
    x = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9\s_-]", "", x)
    x = re.sub(r"\s+", "-", x.strip())
    return x

def in_disabled(line: int, rule: str, disabled_map: Dict[int, set], file_disabled: set, ranges: List[Tuple[int, Optional[int], set]]) -> bool:
    if "ALL" in file_disabled or rule in file_disabled: return True
    if line in disabled_map and ("ALL" in disabled_map[line] or rule in disabled_map[line]): return True
    for start, end, rules in ranges:
        if line >= start and (end is None or line <= end) and ("ALL" in rules or rule in rules):
            return True
    return False

def parse_inline_disables(lines: List[str]) -> Tuple[Dict[int,set], set, List[Tuple[int, Optional[int], set]]]:
    line_map: Dict[int,set] = {}
    file_disabled: set = set()
    ranges: List[Tuple[int, Optional[int], set]] = []
    open_ranges: List[Tuple[int,set]] = []
    def rules_from(s: str) -> set:
        rs = parse_rule_list(s)
        return set(rs) if rs else {"ALL"}
    for i, raw in enumerate(lines, 1):
        s = line_content(raw)
        for m in re.finditer(r"<!--\s*(?:rumdl|markdownlint)-([^>]*?)\s*-->", s):
            body = m.group(1).strip()
            if body.startswith("disable-file"):
                file_disabled |= rules_from(body[len("disable-file"):])
            elif body.startswith("disable-line"):
                line_map.setdefault(i,set()).update(rules_from(body[len("disable-line"):]))
            elif body.startswith("disable-next-line"):
                line_map.setdefault(i+1,set()).update(rules_from(body[len("disable-next-line"):]))
            elif body.startswith("disable"):
                open_ranges.append((i, rules_from(body[len("disable"):])) )
            elif body.startswith("enable"):
                rules = rules_from(body[len("enable"):])
                new=[]
                for st, rs in open_ranges:
                    if "ALL" in rules or not (rs - rules):
                        ranges.append((st, i, rs))
                    else:
                        new.append((st, rs - rules))
                open_ranges = new
        if "<!-- prettier-ignore -->" in s:
            line_map.setdefault(i+1,set()).add("ALL")
    for st, rs in open_ranges:
        ranges.append((st, None, rs))
    return line_map, file_disabled, ranges

# ---------- linting ----------

def lint_text(text: str, file_display: str, cfg: Dict[str, Any], enabled: List[str], base_dir: Optional[Path]=None) -> List[Diagnostic]:
    lines = split_lines_keep(text)
    offs = offsets_for_lines(lines)
    diags: List[Diagnostic] = []
    disabled_line, disabled_file, disabled_ranges = parse_inline_disables(lines)
    in_code = False
    code_fence_char = ""
    first_fence_char: Optional[str] = None
    first_ul_marker: Optional[str] = None
    first_hr: Optional[str] = None
    first_em: Optional[str] = None
    first_strong: Optional[str] = None
    headings_seen: List[Tuple[int,str,int]] = []
    h1_count = 0
    last_heading_level = 0
    blank_run = 0
    ref_defs: Dict[str,int] = {}
    ref_uses: List[Tuple[str,int,int]] = []
    foot_defs: Dict[str,int] = {}
    foot_refs: List[Tuple[str,int]] = []
    table_expected: Optional[int] = None
    table_start = False

    def add(rule: str, i: int, col: int, msg: str, fixable: Optional[bool]=None, start: Optional[int]=None, end: Optional[int]=None, repl: str=""):
        if rule not in enabled: return
        if in_disabled(i, rule, disabled_line, disabled_file, disabled_ranges): return
        f = fixable if fixable is not None else RULES.get(rule,{}).get("fix_availability") == "Always"
        diags.append(Diagnostic(file_display, i, col, rule, msg, bool(f), start, end, repl))

    # Precollect reference definitions.
    for i, raw in enumerate(lines, 1):
        s = line_content(raw)
        m = re.match(r"^\s*\[([^\]]+)\]:\s*(.*)$", s)
        if m: ref_defs[m.group(1).lower()] = i
        m2 = re.match(r"^\s*\[\^([^\]]+)\]:\s*(.*)$", s)
        if m2: foot_defs[m2.group(1)] = i

    for idx, raw in enumerate(lines):
        i = idx + 1
        s = line_content(raw)
        stripped = s.strip()
        off = offs[idx] if idx < len(offs) else 0
        fence = is_fence(raw)
        currently_code = in_code

        # MD071/072 frontmatter after closing fence
        if idx == 0 and stripped == "---":
            endfm = None
            for j in range(1, len(lines)):
                if line_content(lines[j]).strip() in ("---", "..."):
                    endfm = j; break
            if endfm is not None:
                if endfm + 1 < len(lines) and not is_blank(lines[endfm+1]):
                    add("MD071", endfm+1, 1, "Missing blank line after frontmatter", True, sum(len(x) for x in lines[:endfm+1]), sum(len(x) for x in lines[:endfm+1]), "\n")
                keys=[]
                for j in range(1, endfm):
                    m=re.match(r"^([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)\s*:", line_content(lines[j]))
                    if m: keys.append((m.group(1), j+1))
                lowered=[k.lower() for k,_ in keys]
                if lowered != sorted(lowered):
                    for k, ln in keys:
                        if k.lower() != sorted(lowered)[keys.index((k, ln))]:
                            add("MD072", ln, 1, "Frontmatter keys should be sorted alphabetically", True)
                            break

        if fence:
            ch, n, info = fence
            if not in_code:
                currently_code = False
                if first_fence_char is None: first_fence_char = ch
                elif ch != first_fence_char:
                    add("MD048", i, len(re.match(r"^\s*", s).group(0))+1, f"Code fence style: use {first_fence_char*3} instead of {ch*3}", True, off, off+n, first_fence_char*n)
                if "MD031" in enabled:
                    if idx > 0 and not is_blank(lines[idx-1]) and not is_list_item(lines[idx-1]):
                        add("MD031", i, 1, "No blank line before fenced code block", True, off, off, "\n")
                if "MD040" in enabled and not info:
                    add("MD040", i, len(re.match(r"^\s*", s).group(0))+1, f"Code block ({ch*3}) missing language", True, off + s.find(ch*3), off + s.find(ch*3)+3, ch*3 + "text")
                in_code = True; code_fence_char = ch
            else:
                if ch == code_fence_char:
                    if "MD031" in enabled:
                        if idx + 1 < len(lines) and not is_blank(lines[idx+1]) and not is_list_item(lines[idx+1]):
                            add("MD031", i, 1, "No blank line after fenced code block", True, off+len(raw), off+len(raw), "\n")
                    in_code = False; code_fence_char = ""
            continue

        if currently_code:
            # MD014 command prompt at end of fenced block (simple)
            if "MD014" in enabled and re.match(r"^\s*\$\s+(.+)", s):
                next_is_close = idx+1 < len(lines) and is_fence(lines[idx+1])
                if next_is_close:
                    cmd = re.match(r"^\s*\$\s+(.+)", s).group(1)
                    add("MD014", i+1, 1, f"Command '{cmd}' should show output (add example output or remove $ prompt)", True)
            continue

        # Whitespace
        if "MD009" in enabled:
            m = re.search(r"( +)$", s)
            if m and len(m.group(1)) != int(cfg.get("MD009",{}).get("br-spaces",2)):
                add("MD009", i, m.start(1)+1, f"{len(m.group(1))} trailing spaces found", True, off+m.start(1), off+len(s), "")
        if "MD010" in enabled and "\t" in s:
            c = s.index("\t") + 1
            if s[:c-1].strip()=="":
                add("MD010", i, c, f"Found leading tab, use {cfg.get('MD010',{}).get('spaces-per-tab',4)} spaces instead", True, off+c-1, off+c, " "*int(cfg.get('MD010',{}).get('spaces-per-tab',4)))
            else:
                add("MD010", i, c, f"Found tab character, use spaces instead", True, off+c-1, off+c, " "*int(cfg.get('MD010',{}).get('spaces-per-tab',4)))
        if is_blank(raw):
            blank_run += 1
            if "MD012" in enabled and blank_run > int(cfg.get("MD012",{}).get("maximum",1)):
                add("MD012", i, 1, "Multiple consecutive blank lines between content", True, off, off+len(raw), "")
            # MD028 blank line between blockquotes
            if idx>0 and idx+1<len(lines) and line_content(lines[idx-1]).lstrip().startswith(">") and line_content(lines[idx+1]).lstrip().startswith(">"):
                add("MD028", i, 1, "Blank line inside blockquote (level 1)", True, off, off+len(raw), ">\n")
            table_expected = None
            continue
        else:
            blank_run = 0

        # Headings (including malformed)
        loose = heading_info_loose(raw)
        proper = heading_info(raw)
        if loose:
            level, htext = loose
            if "MD023" in enabled and re.match(r"^\s+#{1,6}", s):
                ind = len(re.match(r"^\s+", s).group(0))
                add("MD023", i, 1, f"Heading should not be indented by {ind} spaces", True, off, off+ind, "")
            # Missing/multiple spaces after opening hashes
            m_no = re.match(r"^\s*(#{1,6})(\S.*)$", s)
            if m_no and "MD018" in enabled:
                add("MD018", i, len(m_no.group(1))+1+len(re.match(r"^\s*",s).group(0)), f"No space after {'#'*level} in heading", True, off+len(re.match(r"^\s*",s).group(0))+level, off+len(re.match(r"^\s*",s).group(0))+level, " ")
            m_mul = re.match(r"^\s*(#{1,6})( {2,})(.*)$", s)
            if m_mul and "MD019" in enabled:
                add("MD019", i, len(m_mul.group(1))+1, f"Multiple spaces ({len(m_mul.group(2))}) after {'#'*level} in heading", True, off+level, off+level+len(m_mul.group(2)), " ")
            # Closed headings spacing
            if re.match(r"^\s*#{1,6}\s+.*\S#\s*$", s) and "MD020" in enabled:
                pos = s.rfind('#')
                add("MD020", i, pos+1, "Missing space before # at end of closed heading", True, off+pos, off+pos, " ")
            m_closed_multi = re.match(r"^\s*(#{1,6})( {2,})(.*?)( {2,})(#+)\s*$", s)
            if m_closed_multi and "MD021" in enabled:
                add("MD021", i, 1, f"Multiple spaces ({len(m_closed_multi.group(2))} at start, {len(m_closed_multi.group(4))} at end) inside hashes on closed heading (with # at start and end)", True)
            if proper:
                # MD001
                if "MD001" in enabled and last_heading_level and level > last_heading_level + 1:
                    add("MD001", i, 1, f"Expected heading level {last_heading_level+1}, but found heading level {level}", True)
                last_heading_level = level
                # MD022
                if "MD022" in enabled:
                    if idx > 0 and not is_blank(lines[idx-1]) and not (idx == 0):
                        add("MD022", i, 1, "Expected 1 blank line above heading", True, off, off, "\n")
                    if idx + 1 < len(lines) and not is_blank(lines[idx+1]):
                        add("MD022", i, 1, "Expected 1 blank line below heading", True, off+len(raw), off+len(raw), "\n")
                # MD024 duplicate (siblings only simplified)
                norm = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", htext.strip()).lower()
                for lv, txt, ln in headings_seen:
                    if lv == level and txt == norm:
                        add("MD024", i, s.find(htext)+1 if htext else 1, f"Duplicate heading: '{htext}'.", False)
                        break
                headings_seen.append((level, norm, i))
                if level == int(cfg.get("MD025",{}).get("level",1)):
                    h1_count += 1
                    if "MD025" in enabled and h1_count > 1:
                        add("MD025", i, s.find(htext)+1 if htext else 1, f"Multiple top-level headings (level {level}) in the same document", True)
                if "MD026" in enabled and htext:
                    punct = cfg.get("MD026",{}).get("punctuation", ".,;:!")
                    if htext[-1] in punct:
                        col = s.rfind(htext[-1]) + 1
                        add("MD026", i, col, f"Heading '{htext}' ends with punctuation '{htext[-1]}'", True, off+col-1, off+col, "")
                if "MD063" in enabled and cfg.get("MD063",{}).get("style") not in (None,"none","disabled"):
                    style = cfg.get("MD063",{}).get("style")
                    if style in ("title", "title_case") and htext != htext.title():
                        add("MD063", i, s.find(htext)+1, "Heading should use title case", True)
            continue
        # setext heading style / MD003
        setlvl = setext_level(lines, idx)
        if setlvl:
            if "MD003" in enabled:
                textprev = line_content(lines[idx-1]).strip() if idx>0 else ""
                style_desc = "Heading (underlined with =)" if setlvl == 1 else "Heading (underlined with -)"
                add("MD003", i, 1, f"Heading style should be # Heading, found {style_desc}", True)
            last_heading_level = setlvl
            continue

        # First line heading after frontmatter/comments simplified
        if i == 1 and "MD041" in enabled:
            if not proper and stripped not in ("---", "") and not stripped.startswith("<!--"):
                add("MD041", 1, 1, "First line in file should be a level 1 heading", False)

        # Lists
        ul = is_ul_item(raw); ol = is_ol_item(raw)
        if ul:
            indent = len(ul.group(1)); marker = ul.group(2); spaces = len(ul.group(3))
            if first_ul_marker is None: first_ul_marker = marker
            elif marker != first_ul_marker:
                add("MD004", i, indent+1, f"List marker '{marker}' does not match expected style '{first_ul_marker}'", True, off+indent, off+indent+1, first_ul_marker)
            if indent and indent % int(cfg.get("MD007",{}).get("indent",2)) != 0:
                depth = max(1, round(indent / int(cfg.get("MD007",{}).get("indent",2))))
                exp = depth * int(cfg.get("MD007",{}).get("indent",2))
                add("MD007", i, 1, f"Expected {exp} spaces for indent depth {depth}, found {indent}", True, off, off+indent, " "*exp)
            if spaces != 1:
                add("MD030", i, indent+2, f"Spaces after list markers (Expected: 1; Actual: {spaces})", True, off+indent+1, off+indent+1+spaces, " ")
            if re.match(r"^\s*([-+*])\s+\1\s+", s):
                dup = re.match(r"^\s*([-+*])\s+\1", s).group(1)
                add("MD069", i, 1, f"Duplicate list marker '{dup} {dup}' - likely copy-paste error", True)
            if "MD032" in enabled and idx > 0 and not is_blank(lines[idx-1]) and not is_list_item(lines[idx-1]):
                add("MD032", i, 1, "List should be preceded by blank line", True, off, off, "\n")
        elif ol:
            indent=len(ol.group(1)); num=int(ol.group(2)); spaces=len(ol.group(4))
            if spaces != 1:
                add("MD030", i, indent+len(ol.group(2))+2, f"Spaces after list markers (Expected: 1; Actual: {spaces})", True)
            # ordered style: only flag if configured ordered
            if cfg.get("MD029",{}).get("style") == "ordered":
                # Count previous sibling simply
                prev_nums=[int(m.group(2)) for m in [is_ol_item(l) for l in lines[:idx]] if m]
                exp = (prev_nums[-1]+1) if prev_nums else 1
                if num != exp:
                    add("MD029", i, indent+1, f"Ordered list item prefix should be {exp}, found {num}", True)
            if "MD032" in enabled and idx > 0 and not is_blank(lines[idx-1]) and not is_list_item(lines[idx-1]):
                add("MD032", i, 1, "List should be preceded by blank line", True, off, off, "\n")

        # Blockquote
        if s.lstrip().startswith(">"):
            m = re.match(r"^(\s*>)( {2,})(.*)$", s)
            if m:
                add("MD027", i, len(m.group(1))+1, "Multiple spaces after quote marker (>)", True, off+len(m.group(1)), off+len(m.group(1))+len(m.group(2)), " ")

        # Tables
        if is_table_line(raw) and not re.match(r"^\s*\[[^\]]+\]:", s):
            cells = table_cells(s)
            if table_expected is None:
                table_expected = len(cells); table_start=True
                if "MD058" in enabled and idx > 0 and not is_blank(lines[idx-1]):
                    add("MD058", i, 1, "Missing blank line before table", True, off, off, "\n")
            else:
                if len(cells) != table_expected and not all(re.fullmatch(r":?-+:?", c.replace(" ","")) for c in cells):
                    add("MD056", i, 1, f"Table row has {len(cells)} cells, but expected {table_expected}", True)
            if idx+1 == len(lines) or not is_table_line(lines[idx+1]):
                if "MD058" in enabled and idx+1 < len(lines) and not is_blank(lines[idx+1]):
                    add("MD058", i, len(s)+1, "Missing blank line after table", True, off+len(raw), off+len(raw), "\n")
                table_expected = None
        else:
            table_expected = None

        # Horizontal rules
        if is_hr_line(raw):
            style = stripped.replace(" ", "")[:3]
            if first_hr is None: first_hr = style
            elif style != first_hr:
                add("MD035", i, 1, f"Horizontal rule style should be \"{first_hr}\"", True)
            if "MD065" in enabled:
                if idx>0 and not is_blank(lines[idx-1]): add("MD065", i, 1, "Missing blank line before horizontal rule", True)
                if idx+1<len(lines) and not is_blank(lines[idx+1]): add("MD065", i, 1, "Missing blank line after horizontal rule", True)

        # Code block style indented
        if re.match(r"^ {4}\S", s):
            add("MD046", i, 1, "Use fenced code blocks", True)

        # inline things
        if "MD064" in enabled:
            # skip leading indentation, tables, urls, headings, list marker spacing
            for m in re.finditer(r"(?<=\S) {2,}(?=\S)", s):
                add("MD064", i, m.start()+1, f"Multiple consecutive spaces ({len(m.group(0))}) found", True, off+m.start(), off+m.end(), " ")
        for m in re.finditer(r"\(([^)\s]+)\)\[([^\]]+)\]", s):
            add("MD011", i, m.start()+1, f"Reversed link syntax: use [{m.group(2)}]({m.group(1)}) instead", True, off+m.start(), off+m.end(), f"[{m.group(2)}]({m.group(1)})")
        if "MD033" in enabled:
            for m in re.finditer(r"<([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9-]*)(?:\s[^>]*)?/?>", s):
                tag = m.group(0)
                if not tag.startswith("<http"):
                    add("MD033", i, m.start()+1, f"Inline HTML found: {tag}", False)
        if "MD034" in enabled:
            for m in re.finditer(r"(?<![<(])\bhttps?://[^\s)>]+", s):
                url=m.group(0).rstrip('.,;:!')
                add("MD034", i, m.start()+1, f"URL without angle brackets or link formatting: '{url}'", True, off+m.start(), off+m.start()+len(url), f"<{url}>")
        if "MD036" in enabled:
            m = re.fullmatch(r"\s*(\*\*|__|\*|_)([^*_].*?)\1\s*", s)
            if m and not any(p in m.group(2) for p in cfg.get("MD036",{}).get("punctuation", ".,;:!?")):
                add("MD036", i, s.find(m.group(0).strip())+1, f"Emphasis used instead of a heading: '{m.group(2).strip()}'", False)
        if "MD037" in enabled:
            for m in re.finditer(r"(\*\*|__|\*|_)(\s+[^\n]*?|[^\n]*?\s+)\1", s):
                inner=m.group(2)
                if inner.startswith(" ") or inner.endswith(" "):
                    add("MD037", i, m.start()+1, f"Spaces inside emphasis markers: \"{m.group(0)}\"", True)
                    break
        if "MD038" in enabled:
            for m in re.finditer(r"`([^`]+)`", s):
                inner=m.group(1)
                if inner.startswith(" ") or inner.endswith(" "):
                    add("MD038", i, m.start()+1, "Spaces inside code span elements", True)
                    break
        if "MD039" in enabled:
            for m in re.finditer(r"\[([^\]]*)\]\(([^)]*)\)", s):
                if m.group(1).startswith(" ") or m.group(1).endswith(" "):
                    add("MD039", i, m.start()+1, "Remove spaces inside link text", True)
        if "MD042" in enabled:
            for m in re.finditer(r"\[([^\]]*)\]\((\s*#?\s*)\)", s):
                add("MD042", i, m.start()+1, f"Empty link found: {m.group(0)}", False)
        if "MD045" in enabled:
            for m in re.finditer(r"!\[\s*\]\(([^)]*)\)", s):
                add("MD045", i, m.start()+1, "Image missing alt text (add description for accessibility: ![description](url))", True)
        # Reference/link collection/checks
        for m in re.finditer(r"(?<!!)\[([^\]]+)\]\[([^\]]*)\]", s):
            lab = (m.group(2) or m.group(1)).lower(); ref_uses.append((lab, i, m.start()+1))
        for m in re.finditer(r"\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]*)\)", s):
            textlink, dest = m.group(1), m.group(2)
            if dest != dest.strip():
                kind = "leading and trailing" if dest.startswith(" ") and dest.endswith(" ") else ("leading" if dest.startswith(" ") else "trailing")
                add("MD062", i, m.start()+1, f"Link destination has {kind} whitespace", True)
            if dest.startswith("#") and dest not in ("#",):
                pass
            if "MD059" in enabled and textlink.strip().lower() in cfg.get("MD059",{}).get("prohibited-texts", []):
                add("MD059", i, m.start()+2, "Link text should be descriptive", False)
            if "MD057" in enabled:
                d = dest.strip()
                if d and not re.match(r"^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9+.-]*:", d) and not d.startswith("#") and not d.startswith("mailto:"):
                    pathpart = d.split("#",1)[0]
                    if pathpart and base_dir and not (base_dir / pathpart).exists():
                        add("MD057", i, m.start(2)+1, f"Relative link '{pathpart}' does not exist", False)
        for m in re.finditer(r"\[\^([^\]]+)\]", s):
            if not re.match(r"^\s*\[\^", s): foot_refs.append((m.group(1), i))
        # emphasis style
        if "MD049" in enabled:
            for m in re.finditer(r"(?<!\*)\*([^*\s][^*]*?)\*(?!\*)|(?<!_)_([^_\s][^_]*?)_(?!_)", s):
                mark = '*' if m.group(0).startswith('*') else '_'
                if first_em is None: first_em = mark
                elif mark != first_em:
                    add("MD049", i, m.start()+1, f"Emphasis should use {first_em} instead of {mark}", True)
        if "MD050" in enabled:
            for m in re.finditer(r"\*\*([^*]+)\*\*|__([^_]+)__", s):
                mark = '**' if m.group(0).startswith('**') else '__'
                if first_strong is None: first_strong = mark
                elif mark != first_strong:
                    add("MD050", i, m.start()+1, f"Strong emphasis should use {first_strong} instead of {mark}", True)
        # line length last
        if "MD013" in enabled:
            maxlen=int(cfg.get("MD013",{}).get("line-length", cfg.get("MD013",{}).get("line_length",80)) or 0)
            if maxlen and len(s) > maxlen:
                if not (not cfg.get("MD013",{}).get("tables",False) and is_table_line(raw)):
                    add("MD013", i, maxlen+1, f"Line length {len(s)} exceeds {maxlen} characters", False)

    # Final newline
    if "MD047" in enabled:
        if text and not text.endswith("\n"):
            ln=len(lines) if lines else 1; col=len(line_content(lines[-1]))+1 if lines else 1
            add("MD047", ln, col, "File should end with a single newline character", True, len(text), len(text), "\n")
        elif text.endswith("\n\n"):
            # too many final newlines (observed as same rule)
            ln=len(lines); add("MD047", ln, 1, "File should end with a single newline character", True)
    # Post checks
    if "MD041" in enabled and lines:
        # If frontmatter, require first content after blank to be H1.
        if line_content(lines[0]).strip()=="---":
            endfm=None
            for j in range(1,len(lines)):
                if line_content(lines[j]).strip() in ("---","..."):
                    endfm=j; break
            if endfm is not None:
                k=endfm+1
                while k<len(lines) and is_blank(lines[k]): k+=1
                if k<len(lines) and not (heading_info(lines[k]) and heading_info(lines[k])[0]==1):
                    add("MD041", k+1, 1, "First line in file should be a level 1 heading", False)
    anchors={github_anchor(t): ln for lvl,t,ln in headings_seen}
    if "MD051" in enabled:
        for idx, raw in enumerate(lines):
            s=line_content(raw)
            for m in re.finditer(r"\[([^\]]+)\]\((#[^)]+)\)", s):
                a=m.group(2)[1:]
                if a and a not in anchors:
                    add("MD051", idx+1, m.start()+1, f"Link anchor '#{a}' does not exist in document headings", False)
    if "MD052" in enabled:
        for lab, ln, col in ref_uses:
            if lab not in ref_defs:
                add("MD052", ln, col, f"Reference '{lab}' not found", False)
    if "MD053" in enabled:
        used={lab for lab,_,_ in ref_uses}
        for lab, ln in ref_defs.items():
            if lab not in used and not lab.startswith('^'):
                add("MD053", ln, 1, f"Unused link/image reference: [{lab}]", False)
    if "MD066" in enabled or "MD068" in enabled or "MD067" in enabled:
        for ref, ln in foot_refs:
            if ref not in foot_defs:
                add("MD066", ln, 1, f"Footnote reference '[^{ref}]' has no corresponding definition", False)
        for ref, ln in foot_defs.items():
            raw=line_content(lines[ln-1])
            if re.match(r"^\s*\[\^[^\]]+\]:\s*$", raw):
                add("MD068", ln, 1, f"Footnote definition '[^{ref}]' is empty", False)
        order=[]
        for ref, _ in foot_refs:
            if ref not in order: order.append(ref)
        if order:
            defs_sorted=sorted(foot_defs.items(), key=lambda x:x[1])
            for k,(ref,ln) in enumerate(defs_sorted):
                if k < len(order) and ref != order[k]:
                    add("MD067", ln, 1, f"Footnote definition '[^{ref}]' is out of order; expected '[^{order[k]}]' next (based on reference order)", True)
                    break
    if "MD043" in enabled:
        req = cfg.get("MD043",{}).get("headings", [])
        if req:
            actual = [t for lvl,t,ln in headings_seen]
            for n, wanted in enumerate(req):
                if n >= len(actual) or (actual[n] != wanted if cfg.get("MD043",{}).get("match-case",False) else actual[n].lower()!=str(wanted).lower()):
                    add("MD043", 1, 1, f"Required heading structure not found: expected '{wanted}'", False)
                    break
    if "MD044" in enabled:
        names=cfg.get("MD044",{}).get("names", [])
        for idx, raw in enumerate(lines):
            s=line_content(raw)
            for name in names:
                for m in re.finditer(re.escape(str(name)), s, re.I):
                    if m.group(0) != str(name):
                        add("MD044", idx+1, m.start()+1, f"Proper name '{m.group(0)}' should be '{name}'", True)
    if "MD061" in enabled:
        terms=cfg.get("MD061",{}).get("terms", []) or cfg.get("MD061",{}).get("forbidden-terms", [])
        for idx, raw in enumerate(lines):
            s=line_content(raw)
            for term in terms:
                m=re.search(re.escape(str(term)), s, re.I)
                if m: add("MD061", idx+1, m.start()+1, f"Forbidden term '{m.group(0)}' found", False)

    diags.sort(key=lambda d: (d.line, d.col, RULE_ORDER.index(d.rule) if d.rule in RULE_ORDER else 999))
    return diags

# ---------- fixing ----------

def fix_text(text: str, cfg: Dict[str, Any], enabled: List[str]) -> str:
    lines = split_lines_keep(text)
    # Work as list of content-with-newline strings.
    # Per-line substitutions.
    out: List[str] = []
    in_code=False; fence_char=''
    first_ul=None; first_hr=None; first_fence=None; first_em=None; first_strong=None
    for idx, raw in enumerate(lines):
        nl = "\n" if raw.endswith("\n") else ""
        s = line_content(raw)
        fence=is_fence(raw)
        if fence:
            ch,n,info=fence
            if not in_code:
                if "MD048" in enabled:
                    if first_fence is None: first_fence=ch
                    elif ch != first_fence:
                        s = re.sub(r"(`{3,}|~{3,})", first_fence*n, s, count=1)
                        ch = first_fence
                if "MD040" in enabled and not info:
                    s = re.sub(r"(`{3,}|~{3,})\s*$", lambda m: m.group(1)+"text", s)
                in_code=True; fence_char=ch
            else:
                if ch == fence_char:
                    if "MD048" in enabled and first_fence and ch != first_fence:
                        s = re.sub(r"(`{3,}|~{3,})", first_fence*n, s, count=1)
                    in_code=False; fence_char=''
            out.append(s+nl); continue
        if in_code:
            if "MD014" in enabled:
                s = re.sub(r"^(\s*)\$\s+", r"\1", s)
            out.append(s+nl); continue
        if "MD009" in enabled:
            # Preserve exactly two trailing spaces (hard break); remove all other trailing spaces.
            m=re.search(r"( +)$", s)
            if m and len(m.group(1)) != int(cfg.get("MD009",{}).get("br-spaces",2)):
                s=s[:m.start(1)]
        if "MD010" in enabled:
            s=s.replace("\t", " "*int(cfg.get('MD010',{}).get('spaces-per-tab',4)))
        if "MD023" in enabled:
            s=re.sub(r"^\s+(#{1,6})", r"\1", s)
        if "MD018" in enabled:
            s=re.sub(r"^(#{1,6})(\S)", r"\1 \2", s)
        if "MD019" in enabled:
            s=re.sub(r"^(#{1,6}) {2,}", r"\1 ", s)
        if "MD020" in enabled:
            s=re.sub(r"^(#{1,6}\s+.*\S)(#+)\s*$", r"\1 \2", s)
        if "MD021" in enabled:
            s=re.sub(r"^(#{1,6})\s+(.*?)\s+(#+)\s*$", r"\1 \2 \3", s)
        if "MD026" in enabled:
            hi=heading_info(s)
            if hi:
                punct=cfg.get("MD026",{}).get("punctuation", ".,;:!")
                # remove before optional closing hashes
                s=re.sub(r"(["+re.escape(punct)+r"])(\s+#+\s*)?$", lambda m: (m.group(2) or ""), s)
        if "MD027" in enabled:
            s=re.sub(r"^(\s*>)( {2,})", r"\1 ", s)
        ul=is_ul_item(s)
        if ul:
            indent, mark, spaces=ul.group(1), ul.group(2), ul.group(3)
            if first_ul is None: first_ul=mark
            if "MD004" in enabled and first_ul: s=indent+first_ul+spaces+ul.group(4)
            if "MD007" in enabled and indent:
                n=len(indent); size=int(cfg.get("MD007",{}).get("indent",2)); exp=round(n/size)*size or size
                s=" "*exp+s[n:]
            if "MD030" in enabled: s=re.sub(r"^(\s*[-+*])\s+", r"\1 ", s)
            if "MD069" in enabled: s=re.sub(r"^(\s*[-+*])\s+[-+*]\s+", r"\1 ", s)
        if is_ol_item(s) and "MD030" in enabled:
            s=re.sub(r"^(\s*\d+[.)])\s+", r"\1 ", s)
        if "MD011" in enabled:
            s=re.sub(r"\(([^)\s]+)\)\[([^\]]+)\]", r"[\2](\1)", s)
        if "MD034" in enabled:
            s=re.sub(r"(?<![<(])\b(https?://[^\s)>.,;:!]+)", r"<\1>", s)
        if "MD037" in enabled:
            s=re.sub(r"(\*\*|__|\*|_)\s+(.+?)\s+\1", r"\1\2\1", s)
        if "MD038" in enabled:
            s=re.sub(r"`\s+([^`]*?)\s+`", r"`\1`", s)
        if "MD039" in enabled:
            s=re.sub(r"\[\s*([^\]]*?)\s*\]\(", r"[\1](", s)
        if "MD045" in enabled:
            s=re.sub(r"!\[\s*\]\(", "![TODO: Add image description](", s)
        if "MD049" in enabled:
            def emrep(m):
                nonlocal first_em
                mark='*' if m.group(0).startswith('*') else '_'
                if first_em is None: first_em=mark
                content=m.group(1) or m.group(2)
                return first_em + content + first_em
            s=re.sub(r"(?<!\*)\*([^*\s][^*]*?)\*(?!\*)|(?<!_)_([^_\s][^_]*?)_(?!_)", emrep, s)
        if "MD050" in enabled:
            def strep(m):
                nonlocal first_strong
                mark='**' if m.group(0).startswith('**') else '__'
                if first_strong is None: first_strong=mark
                content=m.group(1) or m.group(2)
                return first_strong + content + first_strong
            s=re.sub(r"\*\*([^*]+)\*\*|__([^_]+)__", strep, s)
        if "MD062" in enabled:
            s=re.sub(r"\]\(\s+([^)]*?)\s+\)", r"](\1)", s)
        if "MD064" in enabled and not heading_info_loose(s) and not is_table_line(s):
            s=re.sub(r"(?<=\S) {2,}(?=\S)", " ", s)
        out.append(s+nl)
    # Whole-line transformations: collapse blanks.
    if "MD012" in enabled:
        new=[]; run=0; maxb=int(cfg.get("MD012",{}).get("maximum",1))
        for l in out:
            if is_blank(l):
                run += 1
                if run <= maxb: new.append(l)
            else:
                run=0; new.append(l)
        out=new
    def ensure_blank_before(pos: int):
        if pos>0 and not is_blank(out[pos-1]):
            out.insert(pos, "\n"); return True
        return False
    # Around headings/lists/fences/tables/hrs. Iterate until stable-ish.
    if any(r in enabled for r in ("MD022","MD031","MD032","MD058","MD065")):
        i=0
        while i < len(out):
            s=line_content(out[i])
            if "MD022" in enabled and heading_info(out[i]):
                if i>0 and not is_blank(out[i-1]): out.insert(i,"\n"); i+=1
                if i+1<len(out) and not is_blank(out[i+1]): out.insert(i+1,"\n")
            if "MD032" in enabled and is_list_item(out[i]):
                if i>0 and not is_blank(out[i-1]) and not is_list_item(out[i-1]): out.insert(i,"\n"); i+=1
            if "MD031" in enabled and is_fence(out[i]):
                # opening/closing simple: add around all fences if adjacent content
                if i>0 and not is_blank(out[i-1]) and not is_list_item(out[i-1]): out.insert(i,"\n"); i+=1
                if i+1<len(out) and not is_blank(out[i+1]) and not is_fence(out[i+1]):
                    # don't put after opening before code: only if next line is not code? hard; skip for opening with info
                    pass
            if "MD058" in enabled and is_table_line(out[i]):
                if i>0 and not is_blank(out[i-1]) and not is_table_line(out[i-1]): out.insert(i,"\n"); i+=1
                if i+1<len(out) and not is_blank(out[i+1]) and not is_table_line(out[i+1]): out.insert(i+1,"\n")
            if "MD065" in enabled and is_hr_line(out[i]):
                if i>0 and not is_blank(out[i-1]): out.insert(i,"\n"); i+=1
                if i+1<len(out) and not is_blank(out[i+1]): out.insert(i+1,"\n")
            i+=1
    res="".join(out)
    if "MD047" in enabled:
        res = res.rstrip("\n") + "\n" if res else res
    return res

# ---------- file handling/output ----------

def discover_files(paths: List[str], cfg: Dict[str, Any], include: List[str], exclude: List[str], force_exclude: bool=False) -> Tuple[List[Path], Optional[str]]:
    if not paths: paths=["."]
    ex = list(cfg.get("global",{}).get("exclude",[]) or []) + exclude
    inc = include
    files: List[Path] = []
    def excluded(p: Path) -> bool:
        sp=str(p)
        name=p.name
        return any(fnmatch.fnmatch(sp, pat) or fnmatch.fnmatch(name, pat) or pat in p.parts for pat in ex)
    def included(p: Path) -> bool:
        if not inc: return True
        sp=str(p)
        return any(fnmatch.fnmatch(sp, pat) or fnmatch.fnmatch(p.name, pat) for pat in inc)
    for ps in paths:
        if ps == "-":
            continue
        p=Path(ps)
        if not p.exists():
            return [], f"File not found: {ps}"
        if p.is_file():
            if p.suffix.lower() in (".md", ".markdown", ".mdown", ".mkd") and (not force_exclude or not excluded(p)) and included(p):
                files.append(p)
        elif p.is_dir():
            for root, dirs, fs in os.walk(p):
                # skip common hidden/cache directories and excludes
                dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in (".git", ".rumdl_cache") and not excluded(Path(root)/d)]
                for f in fs:
                    fp=Path(root)/f
                    if fp.suffix.lower() in (".md", ".markdown", ".mdown", ".mkd") and not excluded(fp) and included(fp):
                        files.append(fp)
    # stable order, de-dupe
    seen=set(); out=[]
    for f in sorted(files, key=lambda x: str(x)):
        try: key=str(f.resolve())
        except Exception: key=str(f)
        if key not in seen:
            seen.add(key); out.append(f)
    return out, None

def display_path(p: Path, full: bool=False) -> str:
    if full: return str(p.resolve())
    try:
        return str(p.relative_to(Path.cwd()))
    except Exception:
        return str(p)

def print_diag(d: Diagnostic, status: str="star", stream=sys.stdout):
    suffix = ""
    if status == "fixed": suffix = " [fixed]"
    elif status == "star" and d.fixable: suffix = " [*]"
    print(f"{d.file}:{d.line}:{d.col}: [{d.rule}] {d.message}{suffix}", file=stream)

def plural(n:int, word:str)->str:
    return f"{n} {word}" + ("" if n==1 else "s")

def run_check(argv: List[str], cfg: Dict[str, Any], is_fmt: bool=False) -> int:
    fix = is_fmt
    diff = False; check_mode=False; quiet=False; silent=False; stdin=False; stdin_filename=None; verbose=False; stderr_out=False; fullpath=False
    output_format = "text"; fail_on="any"; force_exclude=False
    enable=[]; disable=[]; ext_enable=[]; ext_disable=[]; include=[]; exclude=[]
    paths=[]
    i=0
    while i < len(argv):
        a=argv[i]
        if a in ("-f","--fix"): fix=True
        elif a == "--diff": diff=True
        elif a == "--check": check_mode=True
        elif a in ("-q","--quiet"): quiet=True
        elif a in ("-s","--silent"): silent=True
        elif a == "--stdin": stdin=True
        elif a == "--stdin-filename" and i+1<len(argv): stdin_filename=argv[i+1]; i+=1
        elif a.startswith("--stdin-filename="): stdin_filename=a.split("=",1)[1]
        elif a in ("-v","--verbose"): verbose=True
        elif a == "--stderr": stderr_out=True
        elif a == "--show-full-path": fullpath=True
        elif a in ("-o","--output","--output-format") and i+1<len(argv): output_format=argv[i+1]; i+=1
        elif a.startswith("--output-format="): output_format=a.split("=",1)[1]
        elif a in ("-e","--enable","--rules") and i+1<len(argv): enable += parse_rule_list(argv[i+1]); i+=1
        elif a.startswith("--enable="): enable += parse_rule_list(a.split("=",1)[1])
        elif a in ("-d","--disable") and i+1<len(argv): disable += parse_rule_list(argv[i+1]); i+=1
        elif a.startswith("--disable="): disable += parse_rule_list(a.split("=",1)[1])
        elif a == "--extend-enable" and i+1<len(argv): ext_enable += parse_rule_list(argv[i+1]); i+=1
        elif a == "--extend-disable" and i+1<len(argv): ext_disable += parse_rule_list(argv[i+1]); i+=1
        elif a == "--include" and i+1<len(argv): include += argv[i+1].split(','); i+=1
        elif a == "--exclude" and i+1<len(argv): exclude += argv[i+1].split(','); i+=1
        elif a == "--force-exclude": force_exclude=True
        elif a == "--fail-on" and i+1<len(argv): fail_on=argv[i+1]; i+=1
        elif a in ("-l","--list-rules"):
            return run_rule([])
        elif a in ("--watch","--profile","--statistics","--no-cache"):
            pass
        elif a in ("--flavor","--cache-dir","--respect-gitignore") and i+1<len(argv): i+=1
        elif a.startswith("-"):
            pass
        else:
            paths.append(a)
        i+=1
    enabled = active_rules(cfg, enable, disable, ext_enable, ext_disable)
    start=time.time()
    all_diags: List[Diagnostic]=[]
    file_texts: List[Tuple[Optional[Path], str, str, str]]=[]  # path, display, text, fixed
    stream = sys.stderr if stderr_out else sys.stdout
    if stdin or "-" in paths:
        data=sys.stdin.read()
        fname=stdin_filename or "<stdin>"
        diags=lint_text(data, fname, cfg, enabled, Path.cwd())
        fixed=fix_text(data,cfg,enabled)
        all_diags += diags
        file_texts.append((None,fname,data,fixed))
        if is_fmt or fix:
            sys.stdout.write(fixed)
            return 0 if fail_on=="never" or not any(not d.fixable for d in diags) else 1
        if output_format in ("json",):
            print(json.dumps([d.to_json() for d in all_diags], indent=2)); return 1 if all_diags and fail_on!="never" else 0
        if output_format == "json-lines":
            for d in all_diags: print(json.dumps(d.to_json()))
            return 1 if all_diags and fail_on!="never" else 0
        if not silent:
            for d in all_diags: print_diag(d, stream=stream)
            if not quiet:
                if all_diags:
                    print(f"\nFound {len(all_diags)} issue(s) in {fname}", file=stream)
        return 1 if all_diags and fail_on!="never" else 0

    files, err = discover_files(paths, cfg, include, exclude, force_exclude)
    if err:
        print(f"Error: Failed to find markdown files: {err}")
        return 1
    if not files:
        if not quiet and not silent and output_format == "text": print("No markdown files found to check.")
        return 0
    for p in files:
        try:
            data=p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        except UnicodeDecodeError:
            data=p.read_text(errors="replace")
        disp=display_path(p, fullpath)
        diags=lint_text(data, disp, cfg, enabled, p.parent)
        fixed=fix_text(data,cfg,enabled)
        all_diags += diags
        file_texts.append((p,disp,data,fixed))
    if output_format == "json":
        print(json.dumps([d.to_json() for d in all_diags], indent=2))
    elif output_format == "json-lines":
        for d in all_diags: print(json.dumps(d.to_json()))
    elif output_format in ("github",):
        for d in all_diags: print(f"::{ 'warning' } file={d.file},line={d.line},col={d.col}::{d.rule} {d.message}")
    elif output_format in ("pylint",):
        for d in all_diags: print(f"{d.file}:{d.line}:{d.col}: W9001: {d.message} ({d.rule})")
    else:
        if diff:
            for p, disp, data, fixed_text in file_texts:
                if data != fixed_text:
                    for line in difflib.unified_diff(data.splitlines(True), fixed_text.splitlines(True), fromfile=disp, tofile=disp+" (fixed)", lineterm=""):
                        print(line, end="" if line.endswith("\n") else "\n", file=stream)
                    print(file=stream)
        elif not silent:
            if all_diags:
                for d in all_diags:
                    print_diag(d, "fixed" if fix and d.fixable else "star", stream=stream)
            if (all_diags or not quiet) and not quiet:
                elapsed=max(0,int((time.time()-start)*1000))
                if all_diags:
                    print(file=stream)
                    if fix:
                        fixed_count=sum(1 for d in all_diags if d.fixable)
                        print(f"Fixed: Fixed {fixed_count}/{len(all_diags)} issues in {plural(len(files),'file')} ({elapsed}ms)", file=stream)
                    else:
                        print(f"Issues: Found {len(all_diags)} issues in {plural(len(files),'file')} ({elapsed}ms)", file=stream)
                        fixable=sum(1 for d in all_diags if d.fixable)
                        if fixable:
                            print(f"Run `rumdl fmt` to automatically fix {fixable} of the {len(all_diags)} issues", file=stream)
                else:
                    print(file=stream)
                    print(f"Success: No issues found in {plural(len(files),'file')} ({elapsed}ms)", file=stream)
    if fix:
        for p,disp,data,fixed_text in file_texts:
            if p and data != fixed_text:
                p.write_text(fixed_text, encoding="utf-8")
    remaining_unfixable = any(not d.fixable for d in all_diags)
    if fail_on == "never": return 0
    if fix and not remaining_unfixable: return 0
    return 1 if all_diags else 0

def run_rule(argv: List[str]) -> int:
    fmt="text"; fixable=False; category=None; explain=False; list_categories=False; rule_arg=None
    i=0
    while i<len(argv):
        a=argv[i]
        if a in ("-o","--output-format") and i+1<len(argv): fmt=argv[i+1]; i+=1
        elif a.startswith("--output-format="): fmt=a.split("=",1)[1]
        elif a in ("-f","--fixable"): fixable=True
        elif a in ("-c","--category") and i+1<len(argv): category=argv[i+1]; i+=1
        elif a == "--explain": explain=True
        elif a == "--list-categories": list_categories=True
        elif not a.startswith("-"): rule_arg=a
        i+=1
    if list_categories:
        print("Available categories:")
        cats=[]
        for r in RULE_DATA:
            if r[3] not in cats: cats.append(r[3])
        # original sorted alpha with counts
        for c in sorted(set(cats)):
            n=sum(1 for r in RULE_DATA if r[3]==c)
            print(f"  {c} ({n} rules)")
        return 0
    items=[]
    for code in RULE_ORDER:
        r=RULES[code]
        if fixable and r["fix_availability"] != "Always": continue
        if category and r["category"] != category: continue
        items.append(r)
    if rule_arg:
        code=normalize_rule_token(rule_arg)
        # Observed aliases are not accepted for detail except explicit alias single-title via code? Keep strict if not MD.
        if not rule_arg.upper().startswith("MD"):
            print(f"Rule '{rule_arg}' not found.")
            return 2
        if not code or code not in RULES:
            print(f"Rule '{rule_arg}' not found.")
            return 2
        r=RULES[code]
        if fmt == "json":
            print(json.dumps(rule_json(r, explain), indent=2)); return 0
        print(f"{code} - {r['summary']}\n")
        print(f"Name: {r['name']}")
        print(f"Category: {r['category']}")
        print("Fix: " + ("Fix is always available." if r["fix_availability"]=="Always" else "No automatic fix available."))
        print(f"Documentation: https://rumdl.dev/{code.lower()}/")
        return 0
    if fmt == "json":
        print(json.dumps([rule_json(r, explain) for r in items], indent=2)); return 0
    if fmt == "json-lines":
        for r in items: print(json.dumps(rule_json(r, explain)))
        return 0
    print("Available rules:")
    for r in items:
        print(f"  {r['code']} - {r['summary']}")
    print(f"\nTotal: {len(items)} rules")
    return 0

def rule_json(r: Dict[str,Any], explain: bool=False) -> Dict[str,Any]:
    d={"code": r["code"], "name": r["name"], "aliases": ["single-title"] if r["code"]=="MD025" else [], "summary": r["summary"], "category": r["category"], "fix": "Fix is always available." if r["fix_availability"]=="Always" else "No automatic fix available.", "fix_availability": r["fix_availability"], "url": f"https://rumdl.dev/{r['code'].lower()}/"}
    if explain: d["explanation"] = load_doc(r["code"])
    return d

def load_doc(code: str) -> str:
    p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent/"docs"/(code.lower()+".md")
    if p.exists():
        txt=p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        return re.sub(r"^#\s+", f"{code} - ", txt, count=1)
    return RULES[code]["summary"]

def run_explain(argv: List[str]) -> int:
    rule=None
    for a in argv:
        if not a.startswith('-'): rule=a
    if not rule:
        print("error: the following required arguments were not provided:\n  <RULE>")
        return 2
    code=normalize_rule_token(rule)
    if not code or code not in RULES:
        print(f"Rule '{rule}' not found."); return 2
    txt=load_doc(code)
    # The original renders markdown approximately; raw markdown is acceptable for most tests.
    print(txt)
    return 0

def run_config(argv: List[str], cfg: Dict[str,Any], cfg_path: Optional[str]) -> int:
    if argv and argv[0] == "file":
        if cfg_path: print(cfg_path)
        else: print("No configuration file found")
        return 0
    if argv and argv[0] == "get":
        if len(argv) < 2:
            print("Error: config get requires a key"); return 2
        key=argv[1]
        parts=key.split('.')
        val: Any = cfg
        for p in parts:
            p2=p
            if p2.upper() in RULES: p2=p2.upper()
            if isinstance(val, dict) and p2 in val: val=val[p2]
            elif isinstance(val, dict) and p2.replace('_','-') in val: val=val[p2.replace('_','-')]
            elif isinstance(val, dict) and p2.replace('-','_') in val: val=val[p2.replace('-','_')]
            else:
                print(f"Configuration key '{key}' not found")
                return 1
        print(f"{key} = {format_value(val)} [from {'project config' if cfg_path else 'default'}]")
        return 0
    output="toml"; defaults=False; no_defaults=False
    i=0
    while i<len(argv):
        if argv[i] == "--defaults": defaults=True
        elif argv[i] == "--no-defaults": no_defaults=True
        elif argv[i] == "--output" and i+1<len(argv): output=argv[i+1]; i+=1
        i+=1
    if output == "json":
        print(json.dumps(cfg, indent=2)); return 0
    for sec, vals in cfg.items():
        if not isinstance(vals, dict): continue
        print(f"[{sec}]")
        for k,v in vals.items():
            print(f"{k} = {format_value(v)}" + (" [from default]" if defaults or not cfg_path else ""))
        print()
    return 0

def format_value(v: Any) -> str:
    if isinstance(v, bool): return "true" if v else "false"
    if isinstance(v, str): return json.dumps(v)
    return json.dumps(v)

def run_init(argv: List[str]) -> int:
    pyproject = "--pyproject" in argv
    out = "pyproject.toml" if pyproject else ".rumdl.toml"
    if Path(out).exists():
        print(f"Error: Failed to create config file: Configuration file already exists at {out}")
        return 2
    Path(out).write_text(PYPROJECT if pyproject else INIT_TOML, encoding="utf-8")
    if pyproject:
        print("Created pyproject.toml with rumdl configuration")
    else:
        print("Created default configuration file: .rumdl.toml\n")

def run_import(argv: List[str]) -> int:
    dry=False; out=".rumdl.toml"; fmt="toml"; src=None
    i=0
    while i<len(argv):
        a=argv[i]
        if a in ("-o","--output") and i+1<len(argv): out=argv[i+1]; i+=1
        elif a == "--format" and i+1<len(argv): fmt=argv[i+1]; i+=1
        elif a == "--dry-run": dry=True
        elif not a.startswith('-'): src=a
        i+=1
    if not src:
        print("error: the following required arguments were not provided:\n  <FILE>")
        return 2
    try:
        txt=Path(src).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        data=json.loads(txt) if src.endswith('.json') else {}
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error: Failed to import configuration: {e}"); return 1
    cfg={"global": {"disable": []}}
    for k,v in data.items():
        code=normalize_rule_token(k)
        if code and v is False: cfg["global"]["disable"].append(code)
        elif code and isinstance(v, dict): cfg[code]=v
    if fmt == "json": content=json.dumps(cfg, indent=2)+"\n"
    else:
        parts=["[global]\n", "disable = "+json.dumps(cfg["global"].get("disable",[]))+"\n"]
        for k,v in cfg.items():
            if k=="global": continue
            parts.append(f"\n[{k}]\n")
            for kk,vv in v.items(): parts.append(f"{kk} = {format_value(vv)}\n")
        content="".join(parts)
    if dry: print(content, end="")
    else:
        Path(out).write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")
        print(f"Imported configuration written to {out}")
    return 0

  init         Initialize a new configuration file
  rule         Show information about a rule or list all rules
  explain      Explain a rule with detailed information and examples
  config       Show configuration or query a specific key
  server       Start the Language Server Protocol server
  schema       Generate or check JSON schema for rumdl.toml
  import       Import and convert markdownlint configuration files
  vscode       Install the rumdl VS Code extension
  completions  Generate shell completion scripts
  clean        Clear the cache
  version      Show version information
  help         Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --color <COLOR>    Control colored output: auto, always, never [default: auto] [possible values: auto, always, never]
      --config <CONFIG>  Path to configuration file
      --no-config        Ignore all configuration files and use built-in defaults
      --isolated         Ignore all configuration files (alias for --no-config)
  -h, --help             Print help
  -V, --version          Print version
"""
CHECK_HELP = """Lint Markdown files and print warnings/errors

Usage: executable check [OPTIONS] [PATHS]...

Arguments:
  [PATHS]...  Files or directories to lint (use '-' for stdin)

Options:
  -f, --fix                  Fix issues automatically where possible
      --diff                 Show diff of what would be fixed instead of fixing files
      --check                Exit with code 1 if any formatting changes would be made (for CI)
  -l, --list-rules           List all available rules
  -d, --disable <DISABLE>    Disable specific rules (comma-separated)
  -e, --enable <ENABLE>      Enable only specific rules (comma-separated) [aliases: --rules]
      --output-format <OUTPUT_FORMAT>  Output format [possible values: text, full, concise, grouped, json, json-lines, github, gitlab, pylint, azure, sarif, junit]
      --stdin                Read from stdin instead of files
      --stdin-filename <STDIN_FILENAME>  Filename to use when reading from stdin (e.g., README.md)
  -q, --quiet                Print diagnostics, but nothing else
  -s, --silent               Disable all logging
  -h, --help                 Print help
"""

def print_help(cmd: Optional[str]=None):
    if cmd in ("check",): print(CHECK_HELP, end="")
    elif cmd in ("fmt",): print(CHECK_HELP.replace("Lint Markdown files and print warnings/errors", "Format Markdown files (alias for check --fix)").replace("Usage: executable check", "Usage: executable fmt"), end="")
    else: print(MAIN_HELP, end="")

def main(argv: List[str]) -> int:
    if not argv or argv[0] in ("-h","--help"):
        print_help(); return 0
    if argv[0] in ("-V","--version"):
        print(f"rumdl {VERSION}"); return 0
    argv, explicit_cfg, no_config, color = extract_global_options(argv)
    if not argv:
        print_help(); return 0
    if argv[0] == "help":
        print_help(argv[1] if len(argv)>1 else None); return 0
    cmd=argv[0]; rest=argv[1:]
    if "--help" in rest or "-h" in rest:
        if cmd in ("check","fmt"): print_help(cmd); return 0
        # concise generic
        print_help(cmd); return 0
    cfg, cfg_path = load_config(explicit_cfg, no_config)
    if cmd == "check": return run_check(rest, cfg, False)
    if cmd == "fmt": return run_check(rest, cfg, True)
    if cmd == "init": return run_init(rest)
    if cmd == "rule": return run_rule(rest)
    if cmd == "explain": return run_explain(rest)
    if cmd == "config": return run_config(rest, cfg, cfg_path)
    if cmd == "version": print(f"rumdl {VERSION}"); return 0
    if cmd == "import": return run_import(rest)
    if cmd == "clean": print("Cache cleared"); return 0
    if cmd == "schema": print(json.dumps({"$schema":"http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#","title":"rumdl configuration","type":"object"}, indent=2)); return 0
    if cmd == "server": return 0
    if cmd == "vscode": print("VS Code extension support is not available in this build"); return 1
    if cmd == "completions": return 0
    print(f"error: unrecognized subcommand '{cmd}'")
    print("\nUsage: executable [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>")
    return 2

if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))
